projects.title: LLM Replay
projects.description: Point any AI agent at this proxy and watch its entire decision process in real-time. See every request, tool call, and response. Get automatic warnings when it loops, ignores errors, or wastes tokens. Edit any step and replay from that point to test what-if scenarios.

projects.title: CineLens
projects.description: Give it a movie screenshot and a film name. It tells you who's on screen, what objects are visible, describes the scene, and finds shopping links for anything the characters are wearing. All with live progress streaming so you're not staring at a blank screen for 2 minutes.
